verdict.rationale: Otter documents a first-party MCP Server that connects meeting transcripts and action items to AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT. It is OAuth-authenticated with granular per-meeting permissions and supports search and cross-meeting analysis, so it directly delivers the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed setup and tool-reference documentation (endpoint, tool list, plan availability) beyond the marketing and blog descriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI chat tools can securely access your meeting knowledge through Otter's MCP Server for deeper analysis and smarter workflows.
Connect Otter.ai meeting transcripts and action items to Claude via MCP. Search, recap, and draft follow-ups without leaving the chat.
Otter's MCP Server connects your meeting data directly to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, bringing your meeting intelligence into your everyday AI workflows.
OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize
